description: Quality of cited source evidence and of the GreenHub screening value are recorded separately. A literature/market source does not make a derived analogue price directly applicable to GreenHub product grade.

Protein product.source_location: Source price table; potato feed protein and soy protein concentrate rows
Protein product.basis: The table reports comparator prices, but €1,600/t is a selected screening value, not a quoted roadside-grass protein price.
Protein product.applicability: Low-transferability feed-protein analogue; roadside-grass product grade and buyer acceptance are unverified.
Protein product.uncertainty: Source comparator range €800–€2,800/t; selected model base is not a confidence estimate.

Biomethane.source_title: Biomethane production costs, commodity price [gas], and GO prices, 2025 (EUR/MWh)
Biomethane.source_location: Slide 27; metric ‘TTF + GO price - Waste’, Average / Min / Max
Biomethane.basis: ACER reports the exact screening_base of €60.51/MWh as the 2025 average for waste-derived biomethane TTF plus GO; reported min €49.87/MWh and max €75.10/MWh.
Biomethane.applicability: Source is Netherlands/Germany/Denmark waste-derived biomethane market data; not a guaranteed GreenHub offtake price, and the certificate/sustainability attribute must match.
Biomethane.uncertainty: Observed 2025 market min–max, not a probability interval; do not combine with subsidy revenue without checking certificate basis.

Press cake.basis: €65/t is the selected midpoint of a €40–€90/t silage-grass comparator range, not a press-cake quote.
Press cake.applicability: Analogue only; press-cake dry matter, contaminants, feed safety, digestibility, logistics and buyer specification are not matched.
Press cake.uncertainty: Source range €40–€90/t describes a different product.

Ammonium product.source_location: Ammonium sulfate (ZA 3mm) row; €315/t bulk; displayed day prices dated 4 April 2024
Ammonium product.basis: The €315/t screening base directly matches the listed bulk price, but the listing is historical and the nutrient grade/product is conventional ammonium sulfate fertilizer.
Ammonium product.applicability: Not a current quote for recovered ammonium liquor or salt; concentration, counterion, purity, contaminants, registration and product grade are unmatched.
Ammonium product.uncertainty: Historical supplier list price; no current offer or project offtake contract.

Phosphorus/struvite product.source_title: Dutch struvite market assessment summarized by ESPP and WUR
Phosphorus/struvite product.source_location: Market assessment discussion of realistic market value and hypothetical nutrient substitution value
Phosphorus/struvite product.basis: €150/t is an analyst-selected screening value between reported context values; it is not a direct current sale quote.
Phosphorus/struvite product.applicability: Price depends on P content, product form, contaminant limits, registration, agronomic availability and buyer. The underlying reference is dated 2016.
Phosphorus/struvite product.uncertainty: Source-context values are approximately €55/t and up to €350/t for hypothetical nutrient substitution; neither bounds a current quote.

Potassium concentrate.source_title: North Rhine-Westphalia agricultural fertilizer price bulletin
Potassium concentrate.source_location: 19 October 2026 bulletin; 60% K2O granular potash entries
Potassium concentrate.basis: €450/t is an indicative comparator selected from conventional fertilizer prices; not a recovered potassium-concentrate quote.
Potassium concentrate.applicability: Normalize by plant-available K2O and account for impurities, processing, logistics and product-grade discounts.
Potassium concentrate.uncertainty: The benchmark is a conventional fertilizer comparator, not a probability distribution or recovered-product market.

Recovered water.source_title: Dutch water-reuse project and industrial water-tariff references
Recovered water.source_location: Harnaschpolder reuse-cost comparison and VEMW large-business water tariff report
Recovered water.basis: €1.00/m³ is a screening avoided-cost value selected from reported reuse-cost and tariff references; it is not a sale price.
Recovered water.applicability: Only an avoided purchase cost if recovered water meets the user's process-water specification and a substitutable purchase exists.
Recovered water.uncertainty: Reference values span €0.80–€1.56/m³ and are site/customer dependent.

Nutrient-rich solids.source_location: Silage-grass price comparator; project-plan concept is not a market transaction
Nutrient-rich solids.basis: €40/t is an explicit scenario placeholder transferred from forage value; no price for this heterogeneous product is sourced.
Nutrient-rich solids.applicability: Requires measured dry matter, NPK, contaminants, pathogens, stability, legal status and a buyer; otherwise value may be zero or disposal-cost negative.

Ion-exchange product.source_location: ZA 3mm comparator only; no price for a generic ion-exchange product
Ion-exchange product.basis: Base price €0/t is a deliberate no-revenue placeholder until a named saleable product and buyer are defined.
Ion-exchange product.applicability: Loaded resin, eluate and recovered ions are not interchangeable with fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate.

Biomethane (user all-in direct basis).source_title: User-provided TTF gas plus Guarantees of Origin screening range
Biomethane (user all-in direct basis).source_location: User-provided price table; molecule and GO ranges; midpoint €0.88/m³
Biomethane (user all-in direct basis).basis: €0.88/m³ is the user's all-in 20°C dry-gas screening assumption; it is not the ACER €60.51/MWh observation.
Biomethane (user all-in direct basis).applicability: Gas specification, injection, GO eligibility, sustainability proof, subsidy stacking and offtake remain unverified.

Biostimulant concentrate.basis: Explicit user assumption, not an independently sourced market price.
Biostimulant concentrate.applicability: Grade, actual VCF, concentration, registration, stability, offtake and buyer acceptance are unverified.

dry_protein_product.basis: WUR feed-protein analogues; selected €1.60/kg screening point is not a grass-protein quote.
dry_protein_product.uncertainty: Source comparator range €0.80–€2.80/kg; roadside product grade unverified.

biostimulant_product.basis: User-supplied project screening assumption; market and product grade not verified.

biomethane.basis: User-provided €0.88/m³ all-in gas plus GO screening value; source is not the ACER EUR/MWh benchmark.
biomethane.uncertainty: User range €0.59–€1.17/m³; specification and eligibility unverified.

market_reference.source_title: ACER 2025 waste-derived biomethane TTF + GO average
market_reference.note: Separate market reference; not substituted for the user-selected €0.88/m³ price.

phosphorus_product.basis: User-provided price and explicit FX assumption; fertilizer purity and saleable grade are unverified.
phosphorus_product.uncertainty: User range; FX and product specification unverified.

ammonium_product.basis: User-provided price and FX screening assumption; recovered product grade is unverified.
ammonium_product.uncertainty: User range; FX and product specification unverified.

potassium_concentrate.basis: Regional conventional 60% K2O fertilizer comparator; selected €0.45/kg is not a recovered-concentrate quote.
potassium_concentrate.source_title: North Rhine-Westphalia agricultural fertilizer price bulletin
potassium_concentrate.uncertainty: Indicative comparator; recovered-product purity and buyer grade unknown.

press_cake.basis: Dutch silage-grass forage comparator; selected €0.065/kg is not a press-cake quote.
press_cake.uncertainty: Source range €40–€90/t; press-cake moisture, safety and grade unverified.

nutrient_rich_solids.basis: Explicit scenario placeholder based on a non-equivalent forage comparator; no saleable-product price.
nutrient_rich_solids.uncertainty: Product classification and buyer value unknown; may incur disposal cost.
